mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.title, b.writer, m.name AS writer_name, b.view_cnt, b.created_at FROM board b JOIN member m ON b.writer = m.member_id WHERE b.delete_yn = 'N' AND m.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY b.board_id DESC

SELECT b.board_id, b.title, b.content, b.writer, b.view_cnt, b.delete_yn, b.created_at, b.updated_at, m.name AS writer_name FROM board b JOIN member m ON b.writer = m.member_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId} AND b.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (title, content, writer) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writer})
